# A declaration is package-wide, so two files of one package declaring one name
# is a redeclaration -- not a silent last-wins whose consequences surface in
# whichever file lost. This is the CLI's harness rather than a testdata fixture
# because a `testdata/*.sngl` sample is one file, and the bug needs two in one
# package.

# The name goes to whichever file declared it first, and the error names both
# positions. It is reported where the second declaration is written.
! sngl check dup
stderr 'dup/b\.sngl:3:1: "Style" redeclared in this package \(previous declaration at .*dup/a\.sngl:3:1\)'

# The declaration that lost used to overwrite the one that won, so the only
# diagnostic was a field error against the file that was self-consistent.
! stderr 'no field "x"'

# The same two declarations under filenames that load in the other order. The
# winner used to be filename order, which flipped which file the error blamed;
# now the redeclaration is reported either way.
! sngl check flip
stderr '"Style" redeclared in this package'
! stderr 'unknown field "y"'

# Visibility is unchanged: a sibling file's declaration resolves, which is what
# makes the package one declaration set in the first place.
sngl check cross
stdout 'cross/b\.sngl: ok'

# An override says which target it implements and declares nothing of its own,
# so one in a sibling file of the declaration it overrides is not a second
# declaration of that name.
sngl check override
stdout 'override/b\.sngl: ok'

-- dup/a.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Style {
    x int
}

func widthOf(s Style) int {
    return s.x
}

ui.window {
}
-- dup/b.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Style {
    y int
}

component main node {
    text(value=string(widthOf(Style{y = 7})))
}

window {
    main
}
-- flip/a_main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Style {
    y int
}

component main node {
    text(value=string(widthOf(Style{y = 7})))
}

window {
    main
}
-- flip/z_lib.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Style {
    x int
}

func widthOf(s Style) int {
    return s.x
}

ui.window {
}
-- cross/a.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Style {
    x int
}

ui.window {
}
-- cross/b.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func widthOf(s Style) int {
    return s.x
}

component main node {
    text(value=string(widthOf(Style{x = 7})))
}

window {
    main
}
-- override/a.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component mybox(label string) node {
    text(value=label)
}

func caption(n int) string {
    return "n=" + string(n)
}

window {
}
-- override/b.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"

component mybox[html.platform] {
    button(text=label)
}

func caption[html.platform] {
    return "html n=" + string(n)
}

component main node {
    mybox(label=caption(1))
}

window {
    main
}
